videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: Evan is moving to Tokyo, so Rebecca drives him to the airport. However, after she finally confesses her feelings for him, he asks her to pick up the woman who will be going with him.

videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: Greg Stone, the new owner of Cheers, pays a visit to the bar. The ambitious Rebecca pulls out all the stops to make a good impression. However, she is shocked when Stone fires Rebecca and promotes Sam to manager.

videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: Sam swears to three months of celibacy to avoid being named the father of a former lover's baby. Carla warns Sam that God will curse him for breaking the vow. After two weeks of celibacy, Sam asks Father Barry for advice.

videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: Relieved that Greg Stone has been fired, Rebecca is scheduled to meet her new executive vice-president in his office. However, not recognising him in a lift, mainly due to his youth and shortness, she rejects his advances.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
videos.description: Ray is upset when Debra says he is just like his cousin Gerard, and he thinks it would be a good idea to turn to his family for reassurance.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
videos.description: Debra spends a whole day cooking with Marie in an effort to get along with her mother-in-law, and Ray reluctantly agrees to take Robert and Frank to a car show.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
videos.description: Ray worries that he has passed on stupid genes to Michael because his son may be held back a year at school, just like Ray was.

videos.title: Frasier
videos.description: Niles and Frasier attempt to restore lustre to the tarnished career of a favourite Shakespearean actor.

videos.title: Frasier
videos.description: Frasier exists in two Valentine's Day universes, one with a beautiful waitress (Charlotte Ross) and the other alone.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Bart uses a miniature camera to spy on a bachelor party Homer is attending where there is an exotic belly dancer.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Principal Skinner persuades Homer and Marge to place their son on a student exchange programme. Meanwhile, an Albanian child comes to Springfield intent on a spot of industrial espionage.

videos.title: Formula 1
videos.description: Antonelli aims to end his record-breaking year in style, but Verstappen and Hamilton will look to frustrate him. Who'll take pole on the neon-soaked Las Vegas Strip?

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Springfield Elementary hands out Academic Alerts to students who are in danger of failing, and Lisa becomes a student in danger of failing when she gets an Academic Alert for gym class.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: After retrieving a piece of candy stuck to a college co-ed's pants, Homer becomes public enemy number one when the co-ed accuses Homer of touching her butt and the media makes Homer out to be a pervert.

videos.title: Four in a Bed
videos.description: Are super-sized sausages the key to 'Four in a Bed' glory? Lee and Jenni hope so at The Greyhound Inn in the Peak District, where they take their guests to a wildlife park and then wow them with those bountiful bangers at breakfast.

videos.title: Four in a Bed
videos.description: The B&Bers are in the Ribble Valley for the week's second visit, at Jack's Little Middop Farm. Jack's self-catering camping pods in the middle of a field immerse his guests in the heart of nature.

videos.title: Four in a Bed
videos.description: Phil and Gil host the week's third visit at Old Hall Country Breaks in Norfolk. The attention-to-detail at their self-catering accommodation gets the seal of approval from everyone, and Phil and Gil keep them sweet with a chocolatier experience.

videos.title: Four in a Bed
videos.description: Keighley and Justin host the week's final visit at The Half Moon Inn in Norfolk. Experienced chef Justin has piled the pressure on himself throughout the week with some big claims about his culinary chops and egg-cooking skills.

videos.title: Four in a Bed
videos.description: Toilet troubles, tossing and turning, and tears galore. It is a rip-roaring payment day on 'Four in a Bed'. Who has won the week?

videos.title: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It
videos.description: Kirstie and Phil help Amy and Brian solve their predicament over their five-bed chalet bungalow in Newtownards, Northern Ireland. Kirstie comes up with a plan to make their home feel like new, whilst Phil heads out to find them a future-proof home.

videos.title: The Great British Bake Off
videos.description: It's the semi-final and time for the bakers to showcase their patisserie prowess. Their precision, patience and pastry skills are pushed to the limit as they strive to prove they have what it takes to make it through to the final.

videos.title: Channel 4 News
videos.description: Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

videos.title: Ottoman Empire by Train with Alice Roberts
videos.description: Alice takes a train to the westernmost point of the Ottoman Empire, to Budapest, where she learns how close the Ottomans came to conquering all of Europe, and how it all ended. In Timişoara, Alice forensically pursues Ottoman remnants.

videos.title: Griff Across the Alps
videos.description: In Austria, Griff hears a mighty wind howling in a cave called the Mouth of Hell. Later on, he becomes a leader of sheep, dangles from a mountain and visits Mozart's birthplace.

videos.title: A Friend of the Family
videos.description: A trusted family friend picks up Jan after school to go horseback riding, but as nightfall looms and they're still not home, what seemed like a casual afternoon slowly turns nightmarish.

videos.title: A Friend of the Family
videos.description: The search for Jan escalates as the Brobergs call in the FBI. Jan is tasked with a disturbing life-or-death responsibility.

videos.title: Spencer
videos.description: In 1991 while spending the Christmas holiday with the royal family at Sandringham House, Princess Diana decides to leave then-Prince Charles.

videos.title: Gordon Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
videos.description: At Hermosa Beach in California, Gordon attempts to save Patrick Molloy's, a family-owned Irish pub, by refurbishing the dining room and creating a simplified and delicious menu.

videos.title: I Am
videos.description: Helen and Steve seem to have a loving relationship, but as Steve begins to consume misogynistic online porn and the rhetoric of the manosphere, their sexual dynamic shifts from mutual desire to coercive aggression.

videos.title: I Am
videos.description: Helen faces an impossible choice as Steve's façade collapses in a terrifying, violent unravelling, and she begins to plot her escape.

videos.title: The Dog House
videos.description: Rescue dogs seek loving new owners at Wood Green, The Animals Charity, including Olivia the blind spaniel, Bella the confident, playful Staffie, and a shy but cuddly pooch called Cech.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Bart uses a miniature camera to spy on a bachelor party Homer is attending where there is an exotic belly dancer.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Principal Skinner persuades Homer and Marge to place their son on a student exchange programme. Meanwhile, an Albanian child comes to Springfield intent on a spot of industrial espionage.

videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: Mr Teal offers Sam employment at bar in Cancun, Mexico, and hires a one-month exchange bartender. Sam accepts, leaving Rebecca alone and miserable with Mr Teal. One month later, Sam decides he would like to stay in Mexico.

videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: Eddie LeBec returns for a Boston ice show with an attractive East German skater, Franzi Schrempf, making Carla jealous. On the other hand, Sam is desperate to seduce Franzi, who repeatedly rejects his advances.

videos.title: Cheers
videos.description: Frasier and Lilith fire their interior decorator for mocking their taste and notice house-painter Norm artfully rearranging their furniture. Although fearful of losing his reputation as a beer-guzzling lazy nobody, Norm decorates the Cranes' home.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
videos.description: Ray thinks a family portrait would make a great Christmas present for his parents, until Marie and Debra clash over who counts as family.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
videos.description: Ray and Debra have wildly differing opinions of how to react to the news that Ally has been bullying another child on the school bus.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Raymond
videos.description: Ray decides to imitate his father by going to church every week, until he realises why it is he never misses a sermon.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Springfield launches a film festival and `Pocahontas', Barney's haunting meditation on his alcoholism, is on course to win. However, panellist Homer prefers Hans Moleman's `Man Getting Hit by Football'.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Milhouse is forced to toughen up when he learns his parents are lost at sea. Meanwhile, Homer's lack of romantic zeal becomes a problem.

videos.title: The Simpsons
videos.description: Marge starts up a new women-only gym in Springfield and Homer frets about losing her after she becomes a highly successful businesswoman. Meanwhile, Coolsville, a new comic bookshop, opens up in Springfield and puts Comic Book Guy out of business.

videos.title: Sunday Brunch
videos.description: Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, where they cook in the kitchen and are accompanied by the week's celebrity guest.

videos.title: Formula 1
videos.description: Newly-crowned Antonelli has set the pace all year, but last year's winner Verstappen will be looking to continue his run of strong performances. Who'll take the chequered flag in Sin City?

videos.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
videos.description: George Clarke meets a couple who are transforming a tiny one-room Victorian bakehouse into a two-bedroom flat, and a classic car fan who's converting a 1973 Mark One Reliant Robin into a bijoux camper.

videos.title: A Place in the Sun
videos.description: Golf fan Peggy can't think of anywhere else she'd rather buy a holiday home than on Spain's Costa del Sol. Danni Menzies tees up five properties for £115k, but will any score a hole in one?

videos.title: 50 First Dates
videos.description: Playboy vet Henry sets his heart on romancing Lucy, but she has short-term memory loss and can't remember anything that happened the day before. So every morning, Henry has to woo her again. Her friends and family are very protective, and Henry must convince them that he's in it for love.

videos.title: Channel 4 News
videos.description: Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

videos.description: On New Zealand's North Island, from Auckland to Wellington, the Northern Explorer scenic railway traverses amazing Middle Earth landscapes, past active volcanoes to the Kapiti coast, lined with subtropical rainforest.

videos.title: Kevin McCloud's Classic Car Road Trips
videos.description: Kevin explores Sweden in a Volvo that dared to be different: the P1800 Coupé. He visits the car with the highest mileage ever, and has a coupé of coffee with his Swedish self!

videos.title: Stacey Dooley's Australia: Off the Beaten Track
videos.description: At Warrawagine cattle station - the hottest place in Australia - Stacey rolls up her sleeves to get stuck in with the cows, including getting involved in a pregnancy test. And there's also some raw red-dirt driving.

videos.title: Gogglebox
videos.description: Britain's sharpest armchair critics watched: 'Black Doves', 'Children in Need', 'Michael McIntyre's The Wheel', 'I Am Helen', 'Made in Chelsea', 'Steam Train Diaries' and BBC News (The new James Bond).

videos.title: 24 Hours in A&E
videos.description: At Queen's Medical Centre in Nottingham, one of the busiest A&E departments in Europe, 11-year-old William has been hit by a car and thrown 30 feet, 68-year-old Stephen is struggling to breathe, and Ryan has broken his arm while playing rugby.

videos.title: 999: On the Front Line
videos.description: As paramedics treat a woman with chest pains, she goes into cardiac arrest. Paramedics also deal with a man who's collapsed in a pool of his own vomit. And a young man suffers an allergic reaction after drinking an alcoholic chilli shot.

videos.title: Gordon Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
videos.description: At Sacramento in California, Gordon helps out BBQ and seafood restaurant Sandra Dee's. He and his team have just 24 hours to renovate the premises by updating the 20-year-old dining room's faded decor and overhauling the kitchen and menu.

videos.title: A Friend of the Family
videos.description: The Berchtolds and Brobergs grow closer, but as Mary Ann and the girls fall under the spell of their fun-loving neighbour, Bob sees him as a threat.

videos.title: A Friend of the Family
videos.description: The Brobergs fight to restore normalcy as they prepare to face B. in court. Jan's anxiety about the mission snowballs with time. Mary Ann's unanswered questions about Mexico and growing disconnect with Bob lead her to a gut-wrenching decision.

videos.description: Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.' Each installment finds Simon and Tim cooking in the kitchen, accompanied by that week's celebrity guests. Other segments include interviews and highlights from television and film, an expert who assists with drink tasting, a round-up of what is trendy, and the ever-popular `Sunday Brunch Playlist,' which consists of music videos chosen by the presenters and their guests. Guests have included Stacey Solomon, Lisa Faulkner, Tara Reid, Rufus Wainwright and Marina Diamandis.

videos.description: Cliff has appendicitis, but the gang are more interested in Frasier and Lilith's planned countrywide trip, and Frasier visits Cliff at the hospital. Cliff concludes his own behaviour is annoying so tries an unorthodox method to improve it.

videos.title: The King of Queens
videos.description: Doug gets tricked by Tim Sacksky into falling for a pyramid scheme disguised as a way to make large amounts of money selling water filters.

videos.description: When Debra discovers that Ray taped over their wedding video with the Super Bowl, he must go to extreme lengths to make it up to her.
